authority.alpha_prerequisite: C-06i must select rrflowKV immutable-page compression, persisted point-miss filters, cache admission, and value placement from reproducible measurements over the accepted C-06g/C-06h physical stream before any candidate becomes a production format or policy. This first slice creates the clean-revision candidate screen; a later machine-bound slice may retain only candidates that meet the declared correctness and resource thresholds.

current_behavior: rrflowKV segment v4 stores six authenticated Arrow-layout pages per row group with encoding and compression discriminator bytes fixed to none. A standalone Segment::open validates all pages and builds a process-local ten-bit/seven-hash Bloom filter, but normal Database reopen authenticates manifest segments with conservative allow-all filters, so persisted point misses load the key spine. The shared page cache is an exact-byte globally locked LRU with no scan-resistant admission or duplicate-load coalescing. Values remain inline in immutable pages. Current semantic and AI hot-set diagnostics do not bind a clean revision, executable digest, complete hardware/filesystem provenance, a real v4 page corpus, or comparable compression/filter/cache/value-placement candidates. No current evidence justifies Moka, value-log indirection, or a production format change.
target_behavior: Add a default-disabled physical-policy laboratory inside rrd-lsm that builds a deterministic mixed-family MVCC corpus through the real Memtable and segment-v4 encoder, inspects the exact six authenticated page bodies, and executes exact round-trip none/LZ4/Zstandard page-codec trials, serialized Bloom-filter trials with member and absent-key oracles, exact-byte LRU versus scan-resistant segmented-LRU trace trials, an explicitly non-adoptable value-placement byte model, and a real create/flush/close/reopen point-miss characterization through Database. Add a release-profile parent/child benchmark executable that isolates raw trials and records seed, corpus digest, full command, clean Git revision/tree, lockfile and executable digests, compiler/target/build mode, CPU/memory/kernel/filesystem/device metadata when available, warm-up policy, raw timings, percentile summaries, physical/logical bytes, false positives/negatives, cache residency/hits/misses/evictions, real rrflowKV page I/O, and per-family interference. Candidate verdicts use checked-in thresholds and distinguish integrated behavior from codec/filter/cache simulations. This slice selects the separately planned production work; it does not change segment bytes or complete C-06.
unchanged_behavior: RrdEngine remains the sole semantic transaction, authorization, reasoning, recall, installation, attunement, and lifecycle authority. The laboratory writes only temporary rrflowKV databases and evidence selected by an explicit developer command.

WAL v1, batch v2, manifest v3, CURRENT publication, application key format RRKV0001, segment v4 bytes and digests, MVCC visibility, transaction conflicts, snapshot/read-view ownership, compaction, garbage collection, and projected-read behavior remain byte-for-byte and semantically unchanged.

The physical-policy-lab Cargo feature is disabled by default. LZ4 and Zstandard are measurement-only optional dependencies and cannot enter the default linked engine, signed bundle, install path, or runtime dependency closure in this slice.

No Moka dependency is added. A cache implementation cannot replace exact byte accounting or own snapshot/file lifetime, and a simulated hit-rate result alone cannot authorize production cache replacement.

Value separation remains a model-only candidate. It cannot be retained until a later package implements authenticated pointers, atomic WAL/manifest publication, snapshot closure, value-log garbage collection, recovery, range-read, corruption, and failure-boundary tests.
No codec or filter bytes are written into segment v4, no compatibility reader or alternate backend is added, and no rejected experiment remains exposed as a production DatabaseOptions setting.

DataFusion is not added to rrd-lsm. C-06i measures the physical source F-01 will consume; F-01 still owns the stamped asynchronous TableProvider, pushdown, batch, spill, cancellation, and shared resource-ledger integration.

Native graph, scalar, BM25, exact-vector, ANN/TurboQuant, RRF, dynamic context/reasoning, triggers/routines/skills, the installed rrflow binary, SDK/API conformance, and Connectome are not implemented or qualified by this package.

Version 1.0.0 remains frozen, C-06 remains unchecked, and no RocksDB, Lance, SurrealDB, Qdrant, HelixDB, compression, latency, scale, zero-copy, or superiority claim is made from this candidate screen.

research.reason: Compression, filters, caching, and value separation trade CPU, memory, read amplification, write amplification, and recovery complexity. Candidate thresholds and rejection rules therefore come from primary implementation documentation and papers, but only RRFlow's own measured corpus may select a production policy.

sources.title: RocksDB Compression
sources.retained_behavior: Compare page/block codecs by level and workload; treat compression as an explicit CPU-versus-I/O decision and prefer fast codecs for hot data only when measured.
sources.rejected_assumption: RocksDB's codec defaults, option surface, or published ratios automatically fit RRFlow's v4 Arrow-layout pages.

sources.title: RocksDB Bloom Filter
sources.retained_behavior: Persisted filters can avoid point-miss data reads; measure bits per key, false positives, filter memory, and partition behavior.
sources.rejected_assumption: A process-local rebuilt Bloom filter or a nominal ten-bit setting proves normal-reopen pruning or scan benefit.

sources.title: RocksDB Block Cache
sources.retained_behavior: Measure exact cache capacity, admissions, evictions, metadata priority, and scan resistance under mixed access.
sources.rejected_assumption: A generic LRU or cache hit ratio alone proves bounded memory, lifetime safety, or better tail latency.

sources.title: Moka concurrent cache
sources.retained_behavior: TinyLFU-style admission is a useful scan-resistance comparison point and request coalescing is a later concurrency candidate.
sources.rejected_assumption: Moka is required by Arrow/DataFusion or its best-effort bounds can replace rrflowKV's exact byte and generation accounting.

sources.title: lz4_flex
sources.retained_behavior: Use the safe pure-Rust block API as a measured fast-codec candidate with exact round-trip verification.
sources.rejected_assumption: Upstream throughput figures constitute RRFlow hardware evidence or justify a default codec.

sources.title: zstd-rs
sources.retained_behavior: Use bounded block compression as a measured higher-ratio candidate and record encode/decode cost separately.
sources.rejected_assumption: Higher compression ratio is a win when hot-read CPU or tail latency regresses.

sources.title: WiscKey: Separating Keys from Values in SSD-conscious Storage
sources.retained_behavior: Model how large-value separation can reduce LSM compaction bytes while making indirection and value-log garbage collection explicit.
sources.rejected_assumption: A byte model authorizes value separation without atomic pointer publication, recovery, snapshot closure, range-read, corruption, and GC evidence.

sources.title: Apache DataFusion benchmark harness
sources.retained_behavior: Retain raw runs and bind comparison output to command, environment, and exact revision so regressions are reproducible.
sources.rejected_assumption: A DataFusion benchmark or wrapping output in RecordBatch proves rrflowKV physical behavior or end-to-end reasoning throughput.

runtime_trace.reason: No production read/write operation changes in this candidate screen. Existing low-cardinality rrflowKV tracing remains intact; laboratory timing is structured evidence, not product spans.

resource_evidence.reason: Record per-page logical/encoded bytes and codec CPU, filter bytes/false positives/negatives, cache capacity/residency/hits/misses/evictions, actual reopened rrflowKV page reads/loads, value-model bytes, elapsed time, throughput, and child peak RSS for every raw trial.

debugging_evidence.reason: Bind every trial to seed, corpus digest, full arguments, clean revision/tree, Cargo.lock and executable digests, compiler/target/build mode, hardware/filesystem metadata, child exit status, and unfiltered raw observations for exact replay.

first_failure_oracle: The planning-only commit must validate against the exact clean 0dac17d baseline before any source edit.

The real Database characterization must prove that a normal manifest reopen performs filter checks but records zero filter negatives for absent keys inside segment ranges, while the candidate serialized filter has zero member false negatives and stays within its declared false-positive threshold.

Every codec candidate must decode byte-for-byte to each exact v4 page; overflow, unsupported page kinds, truncated output, decompression mismatch, or a claimed saving below the adaptive threshold is a failure or rejection, never successful truncation.

Both cache simulators must return identical requested page identities, remain at or below exact byte capacity after every access, and expose every admission/eviction. The scan-resistant candidate advances only if the declared mixed trace improves retained-hot hits without an accounting regression.
Value separation must be reported model_only and cannot receive a retain verdict in this slice regardless of modeled byte savings.
Clean-evidence mode must reject any dirty worktree, inconsistent corpus digest across child trials, missing provenance, child failure, or non-release build.

stop_conditions: Any path changes outside this exact plan, an existing planned path lacks complete baseline review, or a discovered production defect requires an undeclared repair.

The corpus bypasses the real Memtable/segment-v4 encoder, duplicates the v4 parser instead of using its descriptors, changes segment bytes, or derives expected decode/read results from candidate output.

A codec round trip differs, a filter produces a false negative, a cache exceeds capacity or changes requested identities, the real Database read differs, checked arithmetic overflows, or any trial is silently discarded/retried.
A timing or ratio is reported without raw trials, units, warm-up, exact source/executable/corpus identity, fixed-machine metadata, or explicit uncontrolled-cache/load limitations.
An optional codec enters the default/runtime dependency closure, Moka is added, a value-log or new production DatabaseOptions knob appears, or a rejected candidate remains in normal engine code.
A model/microbenchmark is described as integrated rrflowKV behavior, one host is generalized to all workloads, or C-06/alpha/RocksDB-class/competitor performance is claimed from this screen.
A production policy would be retained without a separately committed machine plan and exact regression tests for correctness, recovery, GC, snapshots, resource bounds, and mixed-family behavior.
DataFusion, graph/BM25/vector/TurboQuant, reasoning/context, install/attunement, routines/skills, SDK/API, Connectome, or release readiness would be claimed or modified in this package.
